text: Discipline OverviewEpidemiology and health statistics are core disciplines in the field of public health, integrating epidemiology (studying the distribution, causes and prevention and control strategies of diseases in the population) and health statistics (using statistical methods to analyze health data and solve public health problems). Its core objective is to reveal the epidemic patterns of diseases through scientific research design, data collection and analysis, and provide a basis for disease prevention, health management and the formulation of health policies. This discipline is the foundation of public health and preventive medicine, and also an important interdisciplinary field for clinical medicine, pharmacy and other specialties.
